packageRules.description: The root package.json resolutions (glob@^10, js-yaml, tar) pin transitive dependencies of the dev tooling to a patched release inside the major those tools depend on. Raising such a pin to a new major forces an API the dependents were not written for, so major updates of resolutions are disabled; patch and minor updates inside the pinned major stay enabled. Remove a pin, or raise it by hand, once no dependency needs the old major any more.
